description: This file defines a chat provider for managing chat state including message history, typing indicator, and message sending functionality, leveraging mock services for testing and future real backend integration.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: A simple data model representing a chat message, including sender, text, timestamp, and unique id.

classes.name: ChatProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based class managing chat messages, typing status, and communication with mock or real backend services.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes chat history, loading mock data if enabled, and ensures one-time setup.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message, adds it to the chat history, updates typing indicator, and fetches a reply from mock or real backend.
